families.about: Hand-written example instances, valid and invalid, for every schema of the 31 file kinds, of resolve.json and lock.json, of the publish and migration reports, and for the dialect's meta-schema.

The published constants as files, not cases: bounds.json (SourceBounds, FormatBounds, the reserved ids), constants.json (versions, kinds, features, producers, limits, Markdig extensions) and profile.json.
A valid and an invalid package for every refusal sentence; each invalid package carries the exact sentence it must produce. The sentences are v31/sentences.json.
families.exportedBy: the sentences: area 00, the contracts; the packages: areas 02 to 08, each for the sentences of the chapters it builds (area 02, parser and file model; area 03, types; area 04, JSON Logic; area 05, resolver and lock; area 06, engine loading and scheduling; area 07, prompts and macros; area 08, checks, deliverables and the profile)
